harness_rendering_notes: A PreToolUse deny leaves NO attachment: it surfaces only as a synthetic is_error:true tool_result whose content is the permissionDecisionReason verbatim, indistinguishable from an ordinary tool failure except by joining the text to fires.db.

A nudge fire leaves two traces: attachment:hook_success (hookSpecificOutput JSON with additionalContext in stdout) plus attachment:hook_additional_context whose content list carries the message verbatim.
A Stop block leaves two traces: a synthetic isMeta user turn starting 'Stop hook feedback:\n' plus attachment:hook_blocking_error whose blockingError carries the message and the hook command string.
Attachments carry the hook command string ('uvx capt-hook run Stop' vs 'rtk hook claude') - the user's global rtk rewriter contributes its own hook_success noise on PreToolUse:Bash.

Fire-log source_file for nudge/gate is the uvx-cached captain_hook/primitives/nudge.py (the user hook file lives only in hook_name's module prefix); declarative hook() rows have an EMPTY source_file and an anonymous name like declarative_1.
Permission denials ('Claude requested permissions to ...') are also is_error tool_results; they join to no fire-log row and must not be confused with hook fires.
